title: The steerability of large language models toward data-driven personas
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the ability of LLMs to align with personas defined by diverse viewpoints, which include religious beliefs and moral values. It explicitly evaluates model prediction accuracy across religious groups (Table 9), analyzes the religious composition of data-driven clusters (Figure 3), and includes responses to ethical and religious questions from the OpinionQA dataset (Tables 12 and 14).
